messages:
emma_cs: FYI escalation from Shoply — they say after last night's deploy their generated order confirmation emails are getting an extra footer: '—This message was generated by AI'. Customer says it wasn't there before and it's breaking their legal template. Can someone grab prompt logs + rollout details?

shoply example pasted to us: (customer supplied)
```
Order #A1234
Items: 3
Total: $42.50
—This message was generated by AI
```

raj_ml: Thanks, emma. Which model/variant are they using? any custom prompt or postprocessing on our side?

emma_cs: They call our hosted API, model pinned to `redwood-006` in their account. No postprocessing on their side, they say. They included a few more examples — all end with that exact footer.

lina_eng: Noted. That sounds like a generation artifact introduced by a prompt template change or model adapter. @raj_ml can you check prompt templates and recent model adapter merges?

raj_ml: On it. Also asking: did they start using function-calling or messages->content wrapping differently? sometimes our system-level prefix sneaks in.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary rollout of runtime/adapter v2025-06-03-2 at 2025-06-03T22:14:10Z (ID: canary-20250603-2).

tom_sre: I can pull the deploy diff. Lina/raj — if it's adapter-level we should be able to repro in canary. I'll spin an instance against that canary image and run a quick prompt.

emma_cs: Customer asked for ETA. I'll tell them we're triaging and need prompt logs + a minimal repro. Can someone outline exactly what we need so I can ask them clearly?

raj_ml: Please ask Shoply for: 1) the exact API request body (system/user messages or prompt string) they sent, 2) the model name + pinned version, 3) any post-process hooks, 4) 3 example responses with request IDs if available. If they can't share full PII, request a redacted minimal repro that still triggers the footer.

lina_eng: Also ask them for `request_id` from our response headers and approximate timestamp of the calls (we can search logs). That speeds root-cause.

tom_sre: I'll grep logs for calls from Shoply org between 2025-06-03T22:00 and 2025-06-04T04:00 and try to find matching outputs. Posting results shortly.

emma_cs: Copying suggested list to Shoply. I'll push for minimal repro and request one raw request/response pair (redacted) + request ids. ETA for customer update: 1h.

raj_ml: If we can repro quickly I can test turning off any assistant system suffixes and re-run. If repro matches, we have a rollback option.

lina_eng: After we get repro, I want to diff tokenizer/adapter configs between stable and canary. Could be a prompt-template accidentally appended as footer in an adapter change.

deploy-bot: canary status: healthy on 3/3 nodes.

emma_cs: Thanks team. I'll update thread when Shoply replies. :thumbsup:
